coordinates.note: transcript-relative only (Ensembl ENST + CutSite / AA position)

reasons: A375 generated 65% of the rows (the whole RES half) and has 0 ATAC-seq/DNase-seq experiments on ENCODE. Its only ENCODE data is RNA-based (['RAMPAGE', 'small RNA-seq', 'total RNA-seq']), so no matched accessibility track exists for the majority of the dataset.
The remaining rows come from three further human lines plus mouse lines, so even a per-row match would need several tracks across two genomes, and TF1 has no accessibility data either.

The Azimuth release carries no genomic coordinates -- only Ensembl transcript IDs and cut positions within the transcript -- so there is nothing to query a bigWig with without a separate transcript-to-genome mapping step.

splits.strategy: gene-held-out (primary); leave-one-gene-out CV for the paper-comparable benchmark; random split reported only as a leakage contrast
